findings.F1: The main measure is on the side the idea predicts but just short of the bar: after up-day closes deep below the 20-day high, the coin fell more than its drift by +1.16 % over 10 days (t 1.99, 628 cases on 463 days, strength 0.084). That is 6.0 times the 0.19 % cost of a trade, but it only offsets a normal drift of -1.14 % in the short direction, so the total move is +0.02 %.
findings.F2: In folds B and C (253 cases), the effect is mixed over time. It is strong in 2018 (+8.1 %, t 4.06, 59 cases) and 2019 (+2.8 %, t 2.53, 71 cases), and reversed in 2020 (-3.2 %, t -1.79, 63 cases) and 2021 (-1.9 %, t -0.83, 60 cases). Windows swing from +11.4 % (w14, t 3.58) to -5.1 % (w17, t -2.69), so the market's own moves drown a modest effect.
findings.F3: Five of the six coins point the predicted way: BTC +2.1 %, ETH +2.3 %, XMR +3.0 %, XRP +2.9 %, LTC +0.8 %, each with 37 to 50 cases. ZEC alone points the other way at -4.1 % (t -1.15, 32 cases), so the effect is broad across coins rather than carried by one.
findings.F4: The grading the idea claims shows on the raw depth in swing units: the deepest quartile's mean unusual move is +5.4 % (t 2.93, 53 cases) against -1.4 %, +0.5 % and +0.6 % in the three shallower quartiles. It is blurred in the standardised forecast, whose quartiles run +0.8 %, -0.5 %, +3.5 % and +1.9 %, which fits step 5's failed deeper-minus-shallower check (-0.17 %).
findings.F5: The effect is on the predicted side at 1, 5 and 10 days (+0.60 % t 1.72, +0.92 % t 1.40, +1.44 % t 1.32 in folds B and C) and gone at 20 days (-0.39 %, t -0.18). The plan's 10-day horizon is where it shows, and the shortfall is one of precision, not of horizon.
findings.F6: More data is available than the test used: 13 further coins have daily bars in the folds (ADA, DOGE, LINK, TRX, UNI, AAVE, AVAX, SOL, INJ, NEAR, SUI, TAO, ONDO). The test ran on six coins only, and its t of 1.99 needs only a modest gain in cases to be told clearly from 0.

ideas.name: deep bounce fades, more coins
ideas.idea: In a choppy market, on a day that closed up, the further the close sits below the coin's 20-day high, in units of its 20-day daily-return standard deviation, the larger its fall over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A bounce that still closes deep below the range top is a day to sell into rather than to buy, and the deeper it sits, the larger the fall that follows over the next ten days.
